verdict.rationale: Metronome shows several bulk-style capabilities. It ingests usage events at high volume (up to 110,000 events/sec) through /ingest. A rate-card price change propagates to all inheriting contracts at once. Existing contracts and invoices can be imported, and data can be exported in bulk to a warehouse. However, nothing documents a general-purpose bulk-operation API or UI for editing, archiving or updating many customers or contracts in one action. Contract and seat edits appear to be per-contract calls. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch endpoints for mutating many objects (customers, contracts, credits) in one request, a bulk UI action, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
